proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ t
  have h : t.orthocenter -ᵥ t.circumcenter = (3 : ℝ) • (t.centroid -ᵥ t.circumcenter) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [t.orthocenter_eq_smul_vsub_vadd_circumcenter, vadd_vsub]
  have hG : t.centroid = AffineMap.lineMap t.circumcenter t.orthocenter (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, h, smul_smul]
    norm_num
  refine ⟨h, hG, ?_⟩
  rw [hG, dist_lineMap_right, dist_left_lineMap]
  norm_num
  ring
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P), t.orthocenter -ᵥ t.circumcenter = (3 : ℝ) • (t.centroid -ᵥ t.circumcenter) ∧ t.centroid = AffineMap.lineMap t.circumcenter t.orthocenter (1 / 3 : ℝ) ∧ dist t.centroid t.orthocenter = 2 * dist t.circumcenter t.centroid
